general.notes: Reach stated as 500 m (0.5 km). Case operating temperature 0°C to 70°C without air flow; storage temperature -40°C to 85°C. Power dissipation < 16 W; total power max 16 W at Vcc 3.3 V. Supply current Icc 4848 mA per table when Vcc is 3.3 V. Forward error correction (FEC) required to be implemented by the host. Receiver sensitivity note 2: measured with PRBS31Q test pattern, BER@2.4*10-4. Receiver sensitivity (OMA) for 0.9dB≤TECQ≤SECQ given as -4.3+TECQ dB; SECQ (stressed eye closure for PAM4) 3.4 dB. Transmit OMA per lane (min) depends on max(TDEC,TDECQ) relative to 0.9 dB and 3.4 dB; TDECQ for PAM4 each lane 3.4 dB. Signaling speed 106.25 ± 50 ppm GBd per lane. Wavelength assignment λ0–λ3 share 1304.5–1317.5 nm range, typ 1311 nm. Optical receiver damage threshold input per lane 5.0 dBm (absolute max); receiver damage threshold per lane 5 dBm. Average launch power off per lane Poff -15 dBm. RINxxOMA (max) -139 dB/Hz.
